title: Secret Garden Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Secret Garden is a 2 BR / 2 BA / 6 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. One of the best-kept secrets of stunning Seaside, the ‘Secret Garden’ cottage lives up to its name, a place where guests are sure to discover an impressive beach home, outfitted with dream-like décor and a comforting vibe.
description_expanded: Description151 Smolian Circle1 KING, 2 TWIN BEDS, QUEEN SLEEPER SOFAWelcome to Secret Garden Cottage in Seaside, FloridaTucked away behind lush landscaping on charming Smolian Circle, Secret Garden Cottage is one of Seaside’s best-kept treasures. This beautifully designed two-bedroom guest cottage offers a serene, storybook setting paired with a prime central location—just steps from the Seaside Amphitheater, downtown Seaside, community pools, and the sugar-white sands of the Gulf. Privately positioned yet close to everything, this cottage is ideal for guests seeking a peaceful beach escape with effortless walkability.A Thoughtfully Designed Two-Bedroom RetreatPerfect for a small family or couples traveling together, Secret Garden Cottage spans two levels and features two bedrooms and two full bathrooms. The first floor is dedicated to rest and comfort, beginning with a romantic king primary bedroom complete with a private ensuite bath. Just down the hall, a second bedroom with dual twin beds and its own private bath provides an ideal setup for younger guests or additional family members. A convenient stackable washer and dryer is tucked discreetly near the staircase for added ease during your stay.Cozy Living Spaces & Fully Equipped KitchenUpstairs, guests are welcomed into a bright and inviting second-floor living area. This space includes a comfortable living room with a queen sleeper sofa, a cozy dining area, and a fully equipped kitchen with ample cabinetry and storage—perfect for preparing meals after a day at the beach. Whether you’re enjoying a family breakfast or a quiet evening in, this level is designed for relaxed coastal living.Outdoor Balcony for Quiet MomentsStep outside to the second-floor balcony, a charming outdoor retreat ideal for sipping morning coffee or unwinding in the afternoon. Surrounded by greenery, this balcony adds an extra layer of tranquility to your Seaside vacation experience.Prime Location on Seaside’s West SideLocated on the desirable west side of Seaside, Secret Garden Cottage offers unmatched access to everything this iconic 30A community has to offer. From the nearby private beach access to world-class dining, boutique shopping, and vibrant community events, guests can truly experience the magic of Seaside—all while enjoying the privacy and charm of this hidden gem.Secret Garden Cottage is a rare find: peaceful, beautifully appointed, and perfectly located. Discover your own slice of Seaside serenity at this enchanting coastal retreat.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum WinterFEATURESPrivate Seaside Residential Beach Access at West Ruskin Pavilion4-minute walk (352 yards) to the beach, home to the largest private residential beach on 30APeacock Alley Premium Linens featuring fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to Seaside Amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome Tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized Guest Services throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking Information: Two parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a vehicle. Golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside; special circumstances or medical needs require an approved golf cart permitNo Pets AllowedSTR23-001872
